# FotoBrowser — full description

> FotoBrowser is a free, local-first photo browser for macOS: an Apple Photos alternative that works with the photos in your own folders and drives instead of a single photo library. No cloud, no account, no subscription.

- Website: https://trnchawla.github.io/FotoBrowser-pub/
- Download (latest release, free): https://github.com/trnchawla/FotoBrowser-pub/releases/latest/download/FotoBrowser.dmg
- Comparison with Apple Photos: https://trnchawla.github.io/FotoBrowser-pub/apple-photos-alternative.html
- Release notes: https://github.com/trnchawla/FotoBrowser-pub/releases
- Bugs and questions: https://github.com/trnchawla/FotoBrowser-pub/issues
- Made by Tarun Chawla

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 15 Sequoia or later; one universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Mac only — no iPhone, iPad, Windows or web version.
- Price: free to download. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no account required.
- Stage: alpha — usable day to day, with rough edges. The download isn't notarized yet, so macOS asks you to allow it once (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway).
- Source code: not public. FotoBrowser is not open source.
- Where photos live: as ordinary files in folders you choose, on your Mac's disk and on external or backup drives. FotoBrowser keeps its own database and thumbnails in one `.fblibrary` bundle (in ~/Pictures by default) that you can move or back up like any file.

## Who it's for

- People who keep photos in folders, or spread across several external and backup drives.
- RAW photographers who want their originals never rewritten.
- People who'd rather not keep everything inside one Apple Photos library, or in iCloud.
- Anyone who wants duplicates found across all their folders and drives.

## Features

### Browsing
- Fast timeline grid with month and year sections and lazy thumbnails, smooth on tens of thousands of photos; a Timeline / Flat toggle per view.
- Full-screen viewer: zoom (pinch, double-click, + / − / 0), pan with the arrow keys, Live Photos with press-and-hold playback, video playback (MOV, MP4, M4V).
- Filters that are remembered across launches: Liked, Printed, media type, Live Photos, RAW (Show All / Only RAW / Hide RAW) and location (Only With / Only Without).
- Albums and favourites (Likes), shared across every copy of a photo; pin, reorder and search albums.

### Your folders and drives
- Watch any folders on any drives. Files are never moved without you. Rescan Folders (⌥⌘R) picks up anything added while the app was open.
- Drive roles: Internal, Master and read-only Vault drives that are never modified.
- Disconnected drives: photos stay in the grid as placeholders from the thumbnail cache, and open at full size from a copy on a connected drive. Deletes and metadata changes for an unplugged drive are queued and applied when it's plugged back in.
- Import from iPhone over USB: copy-only (never deletes from the phone), into a folder you choose, with a "new since last import" date.
- Open from Finder (Open With ▸ FotoBrowser), Open in Preview, Copy Path, Share (AirDrop, Messages, Mail, Save to Files), and drag photos out to Finder or other apps.

### Organising
- Duplicates detected by content across every folder and drive, with safe bulk resolve and Reclaim Space.
- Find Similar Photos: on-device near-duplicate detection (bursts, re-takes) with quality scoring and a fast keep/trash review.
- Clean Up: a focused Keep/Delete review, one day or trip at a time.
- People: on-device face clustering; name, merge, dismiss and remove to correct it.
- Places: where each photo or iPhone video was taken, from GPS, via a bundled offline database, with a small map in the Inspector.
- Events: busy days become events and days away from home become trips named after the place ("Dublin trip"); name, merge, split, pin, hide or set a location on any event.
- Year Memories: a "Best of" for every year, with your strongest shots across the year.

### Fixing metadata
- Set Location: type a place name (offline list, or Apple Maps if you allow it), paste coordinates or a Google/Apple Maps link, or drop a pin. Copy / Paste / Remove Location.
- Set Date/Time for scans, screenshots and wrong-clock photos.
- Both apply instantly in the library, even to thousands of photos, and are written into the files' metadata in the background without re-saving the picture. Every change can be undone; Revert to Original puts back what a photo had before FotoBrowser first changed it.
- RAW files are never written: their location, date, title and keywords go into an `.xmp` sidecar beside them, added to any existing Lightroom or darktable sidecar.
- Titles, descriptions and keywords for stock sites (Shutterstock, Adobe Stock, Alamy), written into the files; Export for Stock makes upload-ready JPEGs with an optional CSV; Suggest Keywords uses Apple Vision and, on macOS 26, Apple Intelligence — on the Mac, only when asked.

### Editing and output
- Non-destructive editing: rotate, crop, and an Adjust panel with Exposure, Contrast, Clarity, a five-part tone curve, Temperature, Tint, Saturation, Vibrance and Black & White (filter and toning effects). Edits live in FotoBrowser's library, never in the original file; Revert to Original removes them.
- Histogram and clipping warnings in the Inspector or over the photo.
- RAW (CR3, CR2, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG and more) and HEIF alongside JPEG; Export RAW as JPEG at full resolution with edits applied.
- Native printing: real photo sizes and tiling, 2-up/4-up grid and caption layouts, optional date stamp, passport-style photo sizes.

## FotoBrowser compared with Apple Photos

| | Apple Photos | FotoBrowser |
|---|---|---|
| Where your photos live | Inside one Photos library package (.photoslibrary) | As ordinary files in your own folders |
| Several drives | One library open at a time; it can live on an external drive | Folders on any number of internal and external drives at once |
| Unplugged drives | The library's drive must be connected to open it | Placeholders in the grid; full size from any connected copy |
| Backup drives | — | Read-only Vault drives that are never modified |
| Duplicates | A Duplicates album inside the library | By content across every folder and drive, plus near-duplicates and Reclaim Space |
| RAW files | Supported | Supported; RAW files are never rewritten (sidecars for metadata) |
| Editing | Non-destructive | Non-destructive, with a tone curve, black & white and a histogram |
| People, places, memories | Yes | People (on-device), Places (offline database, map), Events, trips, yearly Best of |
| Fixing location and date | Changed inside the library | Written into the files' metadata, with Undo |
| Titles and keywords | Inside the library | Written into the files; Export for Stock with CSV |
| iPhone photos | iCloud Photos sync, or import over USB | Import over USB (copy-only); no iCloud sync |
| Other devices | iPhone, iPad and the web through iCloud | Mac only |
| Printing | Through the macOS print dialog | Photo sizes, tiling, grid and caption layouts, date stamp |
| Price | Included with macOS; iCloud storage is extra | Free |

## Moving from Apple Photos

1. In Photos, select the photos (⌘A for all), choose File ▸ Export ▸ Export Unmodified Originals, and pick a folder.
2. In FotoBrowser, click ＋ in the sidebar and add that folder (or drag the folder onto the sidebar).
3. FotoBrowser indexes it and reads the dates, locations and keywords in the files. Nothing is removed from Photos; both apps can be used side by side.

## Privacy

- Photos, thumbnails, file names and folder paths never leave the Mac.
- Anonymous crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics) and aggregate usage analytics (Firebase Analytics) — no photos, file names, folder paths or personal data.
- Optional: an email address for update news, opt-in only.
- The internet is also used to check for updates (GitHub), to show the Inspector's map, and — if you allow it — to look up places in Apple Maps.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is FotoBrowser an alternative to Apple Photos?**
Yes. It gives you an Apple Photos-style timeline and viewer, with albums, favourites, People, Places, Events, yearly Memories and non-destructive editing — over ordinary folders on your own drives instead of one .photoslibrary.

**Is FotoBrowser free?**
Yes. It's free to download, with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no account to create.

**Does it move or copy my photos?**
No. It reads your photos where they are, on your Mac or on external drives. Files are only moved or deleted when you choose to; iPhone import copies photos into a folder without deleting them from the phone.

**Does it change my original files?**
Only when you ask, and only the metadata: a location, date, title or keywords you set are written into the photo's file without re-saving the picture. RAW files are never written (an .xmp sidecar is used). Crops, rotations and colour adjustments stay in FotoBrowser's library. Vault drives are never modified.

**Can I use FotoBrowser and Apple Photos at the same time?**
Yes. FotoBrowser never opens or changes your Photos library, so both can run side by side.

**Can FotoBrowser open my Apple Photos library?**
No. It doesn't read inside a .photoslibrary. Export the originals from Photos into a folder and add that folder.

**Does it sync with iCloud Photos?**
No. Photos stay on your Mac's drives. iPhone photos come in over a USB cable.

**What does Apple Photos do that FotoBrowser doesn't?**
iCloud Photos sync, apps for iPhone and iPad, shared albums, and Memories movies.

**Which Macs does it run on?**
macOS 15 Sequoia or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel.

## Known limitations

- Alpha, and not notarized yet: macOS asks you to allow the first launch.
- No iCloud sync, no shared albums, and no iPhone, iPad or Windows version.
- A RAW and its camera JPEG show as two items (no RAW+JPEG pairing yet).
- New files on an external drive may not appear until you use Rescan Folders.
- Face clustering uses a general-purpose Vision feature print, so it can occasionally mix two people or miss a match; merge and remove tools correct it.
- A video's location, date, title and keywords are kept in FotoBrowser, not written into the video file.
- The full, current list is in the latest release notes.
